$comment: Blind Tier-1 card, rater C, seed 37, build 186d0ac, phone 400x800@3 via tools/browser.mjs, one browser context for the whole horizon. Read only eval/RATING.md, docs/FUN_EVAL_IDLE.md, ../eval-fun/docs/FRAMEWORK.md 1-3, the template. Did not open PLAN.md, research/, CUT*.md, INTEGRATION.md, other cards or source (skimmed the header comment of tools/playtest.mjs for usage only). Audio: none in the build, unassessed. Anchors: ../eval-fun/docs/FRAMEWORK.md section 3, idle boundaries: docs/FUN_EVAL_IDLE.md. bot stays na (caps applied by the coordinator).

absences: 8h simulated once via ?dev=1&absent=8h after 48 min of cold play; 19 min on return
horizon.$notes: Runs watched: r1 bailed at D5 11/36 with $84; r2 died D5 to a goblin archer with $144; r3 returned on my hp<20% rule with $177; r4 returned $91; r5-r7 died D5 to the goblin warlord. Deaths read: 4 (archer, warlord x3). Own edits: unknown item+hp>75% -> drink unknown; foes>=2 -> to corridor (dragged above attack nearest); 75% -> 50%; foes>=2/corridor -> foe: ranged/attack ranged; unknown -> foe: fast + hp>50% -> tame fast; deleted hp<20% return; foe: boss -> cleave (dragged to R2); reordered tame above attack. Offered patches tapped: 1 (hp<20% -> return). Cards bought: kite archers (later deleted to re-enable send), boss focus. Screenshots in scratchpad/raterC: s01 first minute, s31 first death, s16/s19 first edit, s41-s43 return screen, s45 first edit after return.

killCriteria.$notes: darkPattern: a 'rest 20m' label sits next to send after every run but never blocked a send and nothing is sold to skip it; death costs about $110 of banked gold (1173 -> 1063 -> 953) that no screen states, which is a stake I did not explicitly choose but it is not a wait. defaultRules: the forecast for D5 went 56% (defaults) -> 98-100% with my edits. unfair: all four deaths were addressable in the vocabulary (foe: boss verbs, return/retreat). return: 15 runs, a STALL diagnosis and ~6 affordable unlocks were waiting.

criterion.delayedRecall: same-day: I let the second hero push past D4 with $103 on the line instead of bailing like I had the first time, and my drink-unknown rule paid off twice when the heal it had identified fired at 7 HP. On D5 the header went to !!! and 'boss · counter: unknown', and my own foes>=2 -> to corridor rule kept walking him away from a goblin archer that just kept drawing. He died at $144 with '8 unknown unused', the trace showed 'R2 to corridor hp 3 foes 6 goblin_archer draws' three times, and I knew exactly which line of mine did it.

probes.clarity: I never knew why 'Returned with $50' followed a bail with $84 in the header, why the send button went grey at '6/5' rows, or why 'R1 hp<30% drink heal' sat still while the trace read hp 3 with two heal potions bought.
probes.decisions: At 11/36 with '$84 · death: lose all' I bailed; next run at 19/36 with $103 I pushed, and the live FORECAST (D5 56% -> 60% -> 50%) told me which rule edits were worth keeping.
probes.mastery: An hour in I knew that unknown potions never heal you, that rule order is execution order (my tame rule below attack nearest never fired), and that 'hp<20% -> return' is a cap, because the game said 'R1 return ended 16 runs at D5'.
probes.tension: I sweated at D5 with 11/36 and $84 in red text, and when I pushed instead the game answered with '!!!', 'near death' and then 'goblin archer · D5 · 2 over'.
probes.feel: Callouts flick past ('archer draws', 'blades!', '-2 warlord') and the '!' to '!!!!!' escalation reads well, but a hit is a number in the header and the hero sprite barely moves; audio unassessed.
probes.surprise: Monkeys made my gold go down ('$4 -> $1', '-2 monkey'), a shrine said 'Pray, at a price', run 3 found 'heir 1's bones: 12 items', and the warlord's 'shields up / rallied!' loop repeated identically on four D5 visits.
probes.expression: Mine is 'unknown item + hp>50% -> drink unknown', 'foe: fast + hp>50% -> tame fast', 'foe: boss -> cleave' on a greedy L3 fighter, but every offered patch tried to hand me 'hp<20% -> return'.
probes.story: 'Three jackals cornered him to 10 HP; R2 drank; reached D5' and 'Found heir 1's bones: 12 items' are lines I would repeat; the five REEL lines after the night all follow the same template.
probes.pacing: At slow speed there were 40-second stretches of 'pick up' with 36/36 unchanged; auto fixed that; a camp check-in was 3-5 minutes and ended on send; ▶▶| needed ~150 presses to finish one run and stalls behind the in-run VAULT sheet.
probes.failure: 'goblin archer · D5 · 2 over · 8 unknown unused · gap' with a five-row trace of t/R/hp/foes/tele and three patches quoting 'survives 100% · base 8%' told me the cause, the margin and my rule; it never said why drink heal stayed silent at 3 HP.
probes.autonomy: I chose to bail at 11/36, to keep the leash instead of the axe, and to delete the return rule and risk a hero on purpose; where he walks is his.
probes.progression: Within a run: $0 -> $177 and axe +1; between runs: fighter L1 -> L3 across three heirs, ★0 -> ★4, the supplies shelf growing from one leash to eight named potions as I identified them; automation: 'hp<20% -> return' replaced my manual bail and 'auto: restock' cost ◆4.
probes.aesthetic: A dark room of olive tiles with a hero, a rat and a jackal drawn well enough; walls read as static and nothing moves when nobody is fighting; I would not sit in it.
probes.return: I came back to '15 RUNS · D5 BEST · ◆+14 · 0 DEATHS · rested 300m', a STALL card saying 'R1 return ended 16 runs at D5' with a patch offered, 'R2 never fired', $1209 and ◆21; I decided to swap corridor for attack ranged, buy six unlocks and later delete R1; I did not want to stay.
probes.attribution: The last run ended because my R5 attack nearest kept swinging at a shielded warlord at 3 HP; the archer death was my corridor rule; the D5 cap was my return rule; the heal that never fired I cannot place on anyone.

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: Rules, forecast and rule-named callouts are readable, but in an ordinary session I could not explain the gold ('$84' in the run, 'Returned with $50', '$68' in camp), the grey send at '6/5' rows with no message, 'rest 20m', what a bought card does when tapped, or why 'hp<30% drink heal' never fired at 3 HP in three deaths.

Bail-or-push with '$84 · death: lose all' and rule edits scored by a live forecast are real trade-offs I would defend; but the forecast jitters (D5 56/60/50 with no edit), D6 stayed '0%' whatever I wrote, the vault 'choose one' at 'VAULT 0/0' discarded my leash, and the offered patches were three flavours of give up.

D5 forecast went 56% -> 98-100% through my own edits and I learned rule order and the unknown-potion trick; the next thing to learn (how to pass the warlord, 'boss · counter: known') is never shown, so I died to him three times the same way.

Stakes I chose: bailed at 11/36 with $84, pushed at 19/36 with $103 and lost $144 at 'near death'; the header restated my rule as the stake ('$1 · return at 20%'). Lapse: after the night $1209 banked made a $139 run feel free.

axes.note: 'goblin warlord · D5 · 4 over · 2 unknown unused · gap', five rows of t/R/hp/foes/tele and patches with 'survives 100% · base 0%' on one screen, next heir in seconds. Bail, keep, vault-pref chips and deleting the safety rule on purpose were mine; the route is the hero's.

All three layers seen: in-run gold/items, persistent L1 -> L3, ★4, identified potions on the shelf, ◆ unlocks every run (+7, +5, +14); automation: 'hp<20% -> return' and 'auto: restock'. Lapse: after the night $1209 had nothing to buy but $40 potions while ◆ prices climbed (+1 row ◆2 -> ◆7).
Moody olive pixel rooms with a decent hero and jackal, but walls are a tile mush and nothing lives in the frame between fights; no sound.
